# coolify_databases (Data Source)

Lists every standalone database of the token's team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_databases" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `databases` (Attributes List) All databases. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--databases))

<a id="nestedatt--databases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `databases`

Read-Only:

- `image` (String) Docker image.
- `internal_db_url` (String, Sensitive) Internal connection URL.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Publicly exposed.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `status` (String) Runtime status.
- `uuid` (String) UUID.
